To account for these drawbacks, nonlinear periodized programs vary volume and intensity in an undulatory manner. The phases are therefore much shorter in the nonlinear approach. Poliquin (103) originally proposed alternating phases of accumulation and intensification biweekly to optimize a given fitness outcome without overtaxing bodily systems. A popular modification to this approach is the daily undulating periodization (DUP) model. Typically, DUP involves alternating heavy-, moderate-, and light-load sessions over the course of a week.
